title: rotheca aurantiaca
intro: Rotheca aurantiaca, commonly known as the Golden Dewdrop, is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. This plant is traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of fever and cold. The therapeutic actions of Rotheca aurantiaca are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are found in its leaves and flowers.
